# TileMap tools

6 tools. Not registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`; ask for it by name with `GODOT_MCP_CATEGORIES=tilemap`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `set_tile_cell`

Set a tile at a specific cell position in a TileMap layer. Use get_tileset_info first to discover valid source_id and atlas_coords values. Fully undoable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the TileMap or TileMapLayer node. TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+) has a single implicit layer — omit 'layer' or pass 0. |
| `layer` | `integer` | — | TileMap layer index (default: 0) |
| `coords` | `array` | yes | Cell coordinates as [column, row] Array items are `integer`. |
| `source_id` | `integer` | yes | TileSet source ID to use. Get valid IDs from get_tileset_info. |
| `atlas_coords` | `array` | — | Atlas tile position as [x, y] within the source texture (default: [0, 0]) Array items are `integer`. |
| `alternative_tile` | `integer` | — | Alternative tile ID for rotated/flipped variants (default: 0) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/15-tilemap.json`, test TM-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TileMap",
  "coords": "Vector2i(0, 0)",
  "source_id": 0
}
```

## `fill_tiles`

Fill a rectangular region of a TileMap with the same tile. All cells from from_coords to to_coords (inclusive) are set to the given tile. Maximum 10,000 cells per call. Fully undoable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the TileMap or TileMapLayer node. TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+) has a single implicit layer — omit 'layer' or pass 0. |
| `layer` | `integer` | — | TileMap layer index (default: 0) |
| `from_coords` | `array` | yes | Top-left corner of the fill region as [column, row] Array items are `integer`. |
| `to_coords` | `array` | yes | Bottom-right corner of the fill region as [column, row] Array items are `integer`. |
| `source_id` | `integer` | yes | TileSet source ID to use |
| `atlas_coords` | `array` | — | Atlas tile position within the source (default: [0, 0]) Array items are `integer`. |
| `alternative_tile` | `integer` | — | Alternative tile ID (default: 0) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/15-tilemap.json`, test TM-06:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TileMap",
  "from_coords": "Vector2i(0, 0)",
  "to_coords": "Vector2i(2, 2)",
  "source_id": 0
}
```

## `query_tile_cell`

Get the tile data at a specific cell position. Returns source_id, atlas_coords, and alternative ID. Returns is_empty: true for cells with no tile placed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the TileMap or TileMapLayer node. TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+) has a single implicit layer — omit 'layer' or pass 0. |
| `layer` | `integer` | — | TileMap layer index (default: 0) |
| `coords` | `array` | yes | Cell coordinates as [column, row] Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/15-tilemap.json`, test TM-04:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TileMap",
  "coords": "Vector2i(0, 0)"
}
```

## `get_tileset_info`

Get information about the TileSet assigned to a TileMap: tile size, tile shape (square/isometric/hex), and all sources with their atlas textures and tile counts. Use this to discover valid source_id and atlas_coords values before placing tiles.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the TileMap or TileMapLayer node. TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+) has a single implicit layer — omit 'layer' or pass 0. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/15-tilemap.json`, test TM-02:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TileMap"
}
```

## `erase_tile_cell`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the TileMap or TileMapLayer node. TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+) has a single implicit layer — omit 'layer' or pass 0. |
| `layer` | `integer` | — | TileMap layer index (default: 0) |
| `coords` | `array` | yes | Cell coordinates as [column, row] Array items are `integer`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/15-tilemap.json`, test TM-05:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TileMap",
  "coords": "Vector2i(0, 0)"
}
```

## `get_tilemap_info`

Get overview information about a TileMap node: layer count and names, used cell counts per layer, bounding rectangle of all placed tiles, and TileSet assignment.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the TileMap or TileMapLayer node. TileMapLayer (Godot 4.3+) has a single implicit layer — omit 'layer' or pass 0. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/15-tilemap.json`, test TM-01:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TileMap"
}
```
